item.title: U.S. Embassy warns Ghanaian travellers against visa overstays during 2026 World Cup
item.description: The United States Embassy has cautioned Ghanaian travellers planning to attend the 2026 FIFA World Cup against overstaying their visas. It warned that violations of U.S. immigration laws could result in serious consequences, including future travel ineligibility.
